station11_vs_M0_clay.what: lit clay of station 11 against framing/warm-modern-r4/layers/furn/M0.png (4072 x 2290, scaled to the canvas), 128 px tiles, gradient images

depth.what: depth pass of station 11 against the M0 clay's depth pass (scratchpad wm-r4-furn-idx/M0.npz), pixels more than 4 px from a structure edge

structure_vs_base_png.what: structure edges of station 11 (id pass, exact model geometry) against base.png: at a sample every 16 px along each edge, the nearest clear step of base.png across the edge, searched +-6 px (so 6 px is the most this can report). Indicative: cast shadows and texture also make steps

base_png.method: floor pixels of the M0 frame, mean 8-bit luminance per 4 mm bin of world X; a joint = a local minimum at least 3 levels and 4 MAD under its +-4 cm neighbourhood, placed at the dip's centre; 'on a clay joint line' = within 10 mm of X = -2.32 + 0.22 k
